meeting.title: Hearing of Octave Klaba (OVHcloud), Economic Affairs Committee

topics.title: The inquiry report that frames this hearing
topics.why_it_matters: Klaba had already testified on 21 April 2026 to the commission of inquiry, whose report appeared two and a half months before this hearing; deputies quote it.

before.summary: Klaba's earlier hearing before the commission of inquiry (the chair recalls his statement that European public procurement was far too small to build champions).

sources.title: Assemblée nationale: commission d'enquête, phase finale des travaux

before.summary: Inquiry report published: moratorium on new data centres for non-European hyperscalers, European preference in procurement. It computes that of about 15 GW of data-centre capacity expected in roughly five years, only 1.4 GW would go to European operators.

sources.title: Le Journal des Entreprises: un rapport parlementaire demande un moratoire sur les data centers extra-européens
UniversFreebox: un rapport appelle à stopper les nouveaux data centers américains
Assemblée nationale: commission d'enquête, phase finale des travaux

topics.title: The Commission's €180M sovereign cloud contract
topics.why_it_matters: Klaba used it as an example: a start for European providers, but small next to hyperscaler revenue.

before.summary: Tender launched under a new Cloud Sovereignty Framework (eight sovereignty objectives, SEAL levels).

sources.title: European Commission: Commission advances cloud sovereignty through strategic procurement (17 Apr 2026)

before.summary: Awarded: up to €180M over 6 years, four contracts: Post Telecom (lead) with OVHcloud and Clever Cloud; STACKIT (Schwarz Group); Scaleway (Iliad); Proximus (lead) with S3NS, Clarence and Mistral. Winners needed at least SEAL-2.

sources.title: European Commission: Commission advances cloud sovereignty through strategic procurement (17 Apr 2026)

topics.title: OVHcloud: results, leadership and qualifications
topics.why_it_matters: Revenue and qualification claims made at the hearing can be compared with official results as they are published.

before.summary: Octave Klaba returns as chairman and CEO after the CEO's departure.

sources.title: Siècle Digital: Octave Klaba takes the reins again after the CEO's surprise departure (22 Oct 2025)
Fortuneo: OVHcloud passes €1bn annual revenue (FY2025: €1,084.6M, +9.3% organic)

before.summary: Q3 FY2026 revenue €289.6M (+6.9% like-for-like), public cloud +20.2%. FY2026 guidance confirmed: organic growth 5-7%, adjusted EBITDA margin above 2025.

sources.title: Fortuneo/AFP-type wire: OVHcloud accelerates growth in Q3 (FY2026)
OptionFinance: OVHcloud confirms its annual objectives (25 Jun 2026)

before.summary: SNC Cloud Platform obtains SecNumCloud qualification from ANSSI, OVHcloud's third (after Bare Metal Pod and VMware on OVHcloud). A decree of 14 Apr 2026 requires certified cloud for sensitive State data.

sources.title: OVHcloud corporate: SNC Cloud Platform obtains SecNumCloud qualification

after.summary: FY2026 results (year ending 31 Aug) are due after the hearing; the date was not found in the sources searched.

topics.title: Data-centre scale, energy and AI infrastructure in France
topics.why_it_matters: Klaba said a single-site gigawatt data centre will never exist in Europe; a 1.4 GW campus is planned in France.

before.summary: Campus IA at Fouju announced: 1.4 GW, service from 2028, construction expected from H2 2026.

sources.title: Press release: MGX, Bpifrance, Mistral AI and NVIDIA announce a JV for Europe's largest AI campus
FrenchWeb: what a new-generation AI campus looks like

topics.title: Dependence on Chinese open-weight AI models
topics.why_it_matters: Klaba argued Europe's AI depends on Chinese open source, a strategic risk.

before.summary: Aggregator sources report Chinese labs holding five of the ten top trending models on Hugging Face and about 41% of downloads over a year. Not traced to a primary dataset.

sources.title: Tech-Insider: DeepSeek and Qwen top Hugging Face in 2026

claims.speaker: Octave Klaba
claims.text: The €180M contract amounts to about €40M a year shared among 4 winners.
claims.quote_fr: ces 180 millions qui, globalement, vont représenter environ 40 millions par an sur 4 gagnants

previous_checks.evidence: The Commission awarded 'up to €180M over 6 years' = at most €30M a year, not €40M (his figure implies a term of about 4.5 years). The ceiling is also not committed spend. His point (small next to hyperscaler spend) is unaffected.

claims.next_step: 3m/12m: look for call-off volumes actually placed under the contract.

claims.speaker: Octave Klaba
claims.text: AWS earns about €1.2bn a year from the European Commission and Azure about €500M.
claims.quote_fr: environ 1,2 milliard de chiffre d'affaires que AWS réalise avec la Commission européenne par an. Et vous avez un autre 500 millions chez Azure

previous_checks.evidence: No public itemised figure found; the Commission has relied on framework contracts with the US hyperscalers but amounts per vendor were not found. Possibly an estimate covering all EU bodies.

claims.next_step: Search the EU Financial Transparency System, TED award notices and parliamentary questions.

claims.speaker: Octave Klaba
claims.text: OVHcloud makes €1.2bn in revenue and is on the slope towards €2bn.
claims.quote_fr: OVH fait 1,2 milliard et on est sur la pente de 2 milliards de chiffres d'affaires

previous_checks.evidence: Reported FY2025 revenue is €1,085M; with 5-7% organic growth guided for FY2026 (year to 31 Aug 2026) revenue would be about €1.14-1.16bn before currency effects (my calculation), so '1.2' rounds up. The €2bn is an ambition with no date; he declined to give dates, citing listed-company rules.

claims.next_step: 3m: compare with the FY2026 results (due after the hearing). Revisit '2bn' only if a date is given.

claims.speaker: Stéphane Travert (chair)
claims.text: OVHcloud obtained SecNumCloud 3.2 qualification on 1 September for its SNC Cloud Platform.
claims.quote_fr: votre groupe a obtenu, le 1er septembre dernier, la qualification Secnum Cloud 3.2

previous_checks.evidence: OVHcloud announced the qualification on 1 Sep 2026; it is the company's third SecNumCloud qualification.

claims.speaker: Octave Klaba
claims.text: A single address with a gigawatt of electrical power for data centres will never exist in Europe or in France.
claims.quote_fr: les lieux où il y aura un gigawatt de puissance électrique déployée dans un data center, une adresse, pour moi, ça ne va jamais exister en Europe et en France

previous_checks.evidence: In tension with announced plans: Campus IA at Fouju is a 1.4 GW campus (service from 2028, 87 ha, a dozen buildings). A 'never' forecast cannot be proven wrong yet; what can be tracked is whether construction starts and permits are granted.

claims.next_step: 6m: construction started in H2 2026? 12m: phase-1 delivery schedule and grid connection.

claims.speaker: A deputy (not identified)
claims.text: Of 15 GW of secured data-centre capacity in France, only 1.4 GW will benefit exclusively European operators, per the inquiry report.
claims.quote_fr: Sur 15 gigawatts de capacité sécurisée en France, seuls 1,4 ne profiteront qu'aux opérateurs européens

previous_checks.evidence: Press coverage of the report repeats these figures (15 GW, 1.4 GW for European players). The report PDF itself was not opened.

claims.next_step: Open the report and read how the 15 GW and 1.4 GW are defined.

claims.speaker: Octave Klaba
claims.text: Europe relies heavily on open-source AI that is Chinese; innovations come mostly from China.
claims.quote_fr: on fait beaucoup de confiance à l'open source, à juste titre, parce qu'il est bon, mais il est chinois

previous_checks.evidence: Direction plausible: reports say Chinese open-weight models dominate download and trending rankings. But only weak aggregator sources were found, no European-specific figures, and Mistral's open-weight models are a counter-example.

claims.next_step: Find primary data (Hugging Face, OpenRouter usage, academic studies) and any figure for European adoption.

claims.speaker: Octave Klaba
claims.text: OVHcloud has cooled its data centres with water since 2004.
claims.quote_fr: depuis 2004, nous refroidissons les data centres avec de l'eau

previous_checks.evidence: OVHcloud dates industrial-scale water cooling to 2003, with older servers retrofitted by 2004.

claims.speaker: Octave Klaba
claims.text: Redirecting 5-15% of public digital procurement to European providers would create European giants.
claims.quote_fr: Si vous mettez 5, 10 ou 15 %, vous allez créer des géants en Europe

previous_checks.evidence: A position, not a fact. Related decisions: the inquiry recommends a European preference in procurement; the EU awarded its sovereign cloud contract to European providers; no binding percentage found.

claims.next_step: Track the Commission's sovereignty package and any French procurement rule changes.

output.summary: On 2026-10-09, the only verifiable development was a secondary source restating the inquiry report’s 15 GW / 1.4 GW data-centre figures, which supports K6. No new evidence emerged for K1–K5, K7–K9 within the one-day window. K2, K3, K5, K7, K9 remain unresolved pending primary data or milestones. Next steps focus on OVHcloud FY2026 results, report methodology, and Campus IA Fouju construction status.
